messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on inference endpoint /v1/chat for model-group rw-alpha. 5xx spike started ~1802509800, rate now 12% (baseline <0.5%).

alex (oncall): reading it. paging infra and runtime. I'm oncall now. paging @ben for runtime help.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0457 (sev 1) — alerted alex, ben.

ben: looking. can you share which variant?

alex (oncall): monitoring shows errors concentrated on variant `alpha-exp-3` (experimental quant + batch-optim). Traffic split was 25% alpha-exp-3, 75% alpha-stable-1.

mira: ok that matches the deploy window earlier. alpha-exp-3 had a kernel change. suspect memory leak/kvcache eviction causing OOM -> 5xx on some requests.

ben: @alex can you throttle or evict that variant? I can coord rollback afterwards.

alex (oncall): doing quick mitigation: reduce split to 0% for alpha-exp-3 and route to alpha-stable-1. running redwoodctl now.

alex (oncall): ```bash
# reduce traffic to experimental variant
redwoodctl routing patch --model-group rw-alpha --variant alpha-exp-3 --weight 0
redwoodctl routing get --model-group rw-alpha
```

ops-bot: Executed command: routing patched. New split: alpha-stable-1 -> 100%, alpha-exp-3 -> 0%.

alex (oncall): also applying a short-term quota reduction for trial API keys to lower noise while we validate.```bash
redwoodctl quota update --tier free --req-per-sec 1 --burst 5
```

ops-bot: Quota updated for tier 'free'. New limits: 1 rps, 5 burst.

jin: good. can we also add a token-rate limit on /v1/chat to protect backend? small config: 1000 tokens/min per key.

ben: added rule in proxy. config snippet: ```yaml
- match: /v1/chat
  limit_per_key: 1000/min
  action: 429
```

ops-bot: Proxy rule active. Returning 429 for overlimit.

mira: error rate dropping already?

ops-bot: 5xx now 0.9% (was 12%) within 60s of routing change and quota updates. latency back to baseline.

alex (oncall): handing off to ben for the deeper rollback/analysis. I'm available if needed. ben, you take lead. :point_right:

ben: taking lead. I'll keep alpha-exp-3 evicted and kick off rollback to build `alpha-exp-3` previous stable artifact `alpha-exp-2` if we need. first step: validate logs and OOM traces.

ben: quick log excerpt from node serving alpha-exp-3: ```
[2026-02-27T12:01:23Z] OOM while allocating KV cache  size=1.2G
[2026-02-27T12:01:23Z] Unhandled exception -> 500
[2026-02-27T12:01:25Z] Restarted worker
```

mira: yep that's consistent. probably kernel memory path regressed after the optimization PR.

ben: plan: 1) keep variant disabled (done). 2) if stable, rollback routing and promote `alpha-exp-2` as canary at 10% after fixes. 3) run synthetic runs against alpha-exp-3 in staging with stress profile. 4) customer communication.

alex (oncall): we should notify any customers who saw errors. ops run query for customers with >1% of requests failed in last 10m.

ops-bot: Query result: customers impacted: ["acme-inc", "paywell", "edu-labs"] — estimated affected requests: ~3.2k across all keys.

mira: I'll draft a status note for customers and the support team. Short message: we experienced elevated 5xx caused by experimental variant; we've temporarily disabled that variant and restored traffic to stable; no evidence of data loss; we're rolling back the experimental artifact for further validation. ETA for follow-up: 2h for root-cause update.

ben: started a rollback dry-run to alpha-exp-2 artifact in staging to validate perf. command: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy promote --model-group rw-alpha --variant alpha-exp-2 --target canary --weight 10
```

ben: dry-run passed perf checks in staging. will run additional KV stress tests.

alex (oncall): thanks team. adding a note: we applied temporary user-level throttles and a token-rate limit; these could cause 429s for heavy users — support should know to expect tickets and we should correlate to notify impacted customers proactively.

mira: support pinged. message posted in #support-ops with incident link.

pagerduty-bot: On-call handoff: alex -> ben at 1802509930. Incident active.

ben: update: 5xx stabilized <0.5% for 10m. keeping alpha-exp-3 disabled. starting postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0457 (will assign owner + timeline).

mira: good work. follow ups: revert kernel change in PR branch, add canary memory/kv stress in CI, improve alerting to split 5xx by variant earlier.

alex (oncall): closing my oncall tasks. if anything change ping me.

ben: will continue to lead until RCA. tagging @infra for kernel revert.

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV2 at 1802509990 — mitigation validated.

mira: leaving this thread with next steps in the postmortem doc. we'll schedule blameless RCA and rollout plan for a patched alpha-exp-3 if/when safe. :white_check_mark:
